# LondraDepo.com

> UK warehousing, e-commerce fulfilment, customs coordination, pick & pack, and UK distribution services for Turkish and international businesses. Warehouse located in Rayleigh, Essex (near London). Languages: Turkish (main site) and English (/en/, global English, UK spelling). Contact: WhatsApp +44 7554 195190.

LondraDepo helps businesses — especially Turkish exporters and e-commerce brands — sell into the UK without setting up their own UK operation. Services cover the full logistics chain from UK customs onwards: goods receiving, pallet and carton storage, inventory management, order picking, packing, labelling, Shopify and Amazon FBM fulfilment, and UK distribution.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Physical location: Unit 19 Arterial Park, Arterial Road, Rayleigh, Essex SS6 7FY. Road distances: central London ~59 km (~37 miles), London Gateway ~21 km, Tilbury ~26 km, Felixstowe ~99 km
- Warehouse management system: Mintsoft WMS (third-party software, not owned by LondraDepo)
- LondraDepo is the warehousing brand of Arca Trade Group Ltd. International freight (air, sea, road, rail) and customs clearance are provided by Arca Trade Group, not as LondraDepo warehouse services
- Customs clearance declarations are handled by Arca Trade Group's customs clearance team; LondraDepo is not an HMRC-authorised customs or bonded warehouse
- No official Shopify or Amazon partnership — fulfilment is independent third-party service
- Published starting price: standard pallet storage from £3.50 + VAT per pallet per week; all other services are quoted per operation via WhatsApp
- Turkish- and English-speaking support available
- Contact: WhatsApp https://wa.me/447554195190 | Tel: +44 7554 195190
